summary.text: J.M. Lozano is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 43 who has represented the district since 2011 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: J.M. Lozano was raised in Premont, Texas, and attended public schools there.

He received a bachelor's degree in government from the University of Texas at Austin, graduating in 2003, and later earned a master's in business administration from the University of the Incarnate Word.
After college he worked in the office of U.S. Representative Ruben Hinojosa in McAllen.
He owns Wingstop restaurants in Kingsville and Alice.
Lozano changed his party affiliation from Democratic to Republican in March 2012.
His committee assignments in the 2023-2024 legislative session were Transportation, Urban Affairs (chair) and Redistricting.
